Summaries.eng: A peace-loving soldier from Ancient China is magically transported into a world ruled by an evil nine-headed snake. Transformed into a panda, he joins forces with a flying pig to free the once-peaceful Merryland from tyranny. But first, he must train to be the kingdom's most courageous panda warrior.
Summaries.jpn: 平和を愛する兵士は別の世界に運ばれ、パンダに変わります。 家に帰るには、彼は空飛ぶ豚と力を合わせて、かつて平和だった土地を専制政治から解放しなければなりません。
